chunks: Mansur ibn Hazim narrated that Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon them both, said:
If two women testify for the claimant of the right, along with his oath, then it is permissible.

key_terms.لِطَالِبِ الْحَقِّ: for the claimant who is seeking his right

ai.seo_question: Is a claimant's oath accepted together with the testimony of two women in Shia law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning judicial procedure and the establishment of a claim. It states that the testimony of two women together with the claimant's oath is acceptable in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3320 - Mansur ibn Hazim narrated that Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as), said: "
If two women testify in favor of the claimant along with his oath, it is permissible."
